## Summary
<!-- What changed and why. One concern per PR. -->

## Testing
<!-- What ran (make lint test, scoped tests) and what did not. -->

## Dependencies
<!-- One line of reason for each new dependency, or "None". -->

## Issue
<!-- `Closes #N` only when this PR delivers the whole ticket; `Refs #N` for part of it or a spec PR. -->

## Decisions needing the maintainer
<!-- Any choice a reader would want to overrule: behaviour, naming, API shape, privacy, data deletion, data sent
to language-model providers. Write "None" only if there really are none. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch is `<type>/<name>`; title is `type(scope): summary`
- [ ] About 300 (small) or 600 (medium) source lines, at most 800 (`node scripts/pr-size.mjs origin/main`)
- [ ] No other product names, no AI mentions or tool trailers
- [ ] Meeting reads check the member's access; migrations are additive
